name: Rally
idea: A heavy extended italic CNX in deep navy whose X is finished by three 1970s rally stripes that run under the word and kick up to become the X's forward stroke.
why: The stripe is both livery and letter: run it the full length of a van and it rises into the X at the front, so the vehicle itself becomes the logo.
risks: Italic plus speed stripes is a well-worn courier formula (DHL), warm tri-stripes recall 1970s Toyota/TRD rally liveries, and someone primed by the rejected round could still read the kick-up as a tick.

colors.use: Wordmark on light backgrounds; background behind logo-white
